arguments.value: Timothy J. Savage, born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, in 1946, earned his B.A. from Assumption College in 1968 and his J.D. from Temple University School of Law in 1971. He practiced law in Pennsylvania from 1971 to 2002 and served as a hearing examiner for the Pennsylvania Liquor Control Board from 1976 to 2002. In 2002, he was nominated by President George W. Bush and confirmed as a judge of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, where he served until assuming senior status in 2021.
